name: Titania
description: Voice and aspect of the Argoth forest.

description_citations.text: Vanguard Series: card flavor text (Vanguard Series, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Albino Trolls of Argoth fight on Titania's side against the Brothers' insurrection before Argoth's destruction.
timeline.quote: the island of Argoth was home to the Albino Trolls who fought on the side of Titania

citation.text: "Troll", section "Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In Yavimaya Multani, remembering Argoth's devastation, ensorcells Urza in a tree for three years.
timeline.quote: Urza apologizes but is ensorcelled by Multani until he is encased in a tree

citation.text: "Time Streams", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Multani traps Urza in a magnigoth tree at Yavimaya and forces him to feel Titania's pain.
timeline.quote: trapped Urza in a magnigoth tree and forced him to experience all the pain Titania

citation.text: "Urza", section "Atonement for Past Sins". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza activates the Sylex, obliterating Argoth, turning Urborg to swamp and sending Dominaria into an Ice Age; Urza ascends and Gix retreats to Phyrexia.

citation.text: "Timeline/The Brothers' War", section "The War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Titania briefly becomes an avatar of Gaea during the Brothers' War.
timeline.quote: briefly became an avatar of Gaea during the Brothers' War
